(2) A person wearing a maroon shirt carries a brown tray with two white bowls and places it onto a white rectangular table. The background features a vibrant red wall and a beverage refrigerator. (3) Various close-ups show different Malatang dishes: one with dry noodles mixed with sliced beef, cabbage, and broccoli, and another soup-based bowl with pork slices and corn. (4) A metal spoon is used to add white minced garlic and bright red chili paste onto the noodles. Hands are visible during the process. (5) Fast-paced close-ups highlight specific ingredients being lifted by chopsticks: tender sliced meat, translucent crystal dumplings, cylindrical white rice cakes, sliced lotus root with distinct holes, and curly yellow ramen noodles dripping with pale yellow broth. (6) A bowl of 'Malatang Twins' is shown, containing dark brown duck blood cubes and porous tofu in a deep red spicy soup. A piece of braised intestine is lifted with chopsticks. (7) A panning shot reveals the restaurant's interior with wooden-framed booths, black seats, and white tables. The walls are decorated with red and white panels and simple posters. (8) The final shot shows the storefront with a large red sign featuring white characters and a modern glass entrance.
